title: Resolution urging Congress to undo SNAP cuts in federal law
summary: This resolution calls on the United States Congress to repeal nutrition provisions in H.R.1, the federal law known as the "One Big Beautiful Bill," that add work requirements and restrict eligibility for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP). It notes that New York State had an average of 2.96 million SNAP recipients in fiscal year 2025 and that about 300,000 New York households risk losing SNAP benefits by the end of 2026 under the law. It also cites effects on WIC eligibility and on lawfully present non-citizens who would lose SNAP access.
